```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("analysis/human_bulk/config.R")
# Report display options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(table1)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

```

# Combine cohorts

```{r}

counts1 <- read.table(bulk_files$cohort_counts, sep = ",", header = T)
meta1 <- read.csv(bulk_files$cohort_metadata, stringsAsFactors = F)

# Remove rows with duplicated row names
if (length(which(duplicated.default(counts1[, 1]))) > 0) {
  counts1 <- counts1[-which(duplicated.default(counts1[, 1]) == T),]
}
rownames(counts1) <- counts1[, 1]
counts1 <- counts1[,-1]
keep <- rowSums(counts1) >= 0
counts1 <- counts1[keep, ]
meta1 <- meta1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_id != "NULL")
counts1 <- counts1[,meta1$sample_id]
rownames(meta1) <- meta1$sample_id

# Alliance
counts2 <- read.table(bulk_files$alliance_counts, header = T)
counts2 <- counts2[, c(-1,-3)]
if (length(which(duplicated.default(counts2[, 1]))) > 0) {
  counts2 <- counts2[-which(duplicated.default(counts2[, 1]) == T),]
}
rownames(counts2) <- counts2[, 1]
counts2 <- counts2[,-1]

meta2 <- readxl::read_xlsx(bulk_files$alliance_metadata)
meta2 <- meta2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% colnames(counts2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, `Cyto.Group`, Race, Age, Sex) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Batch = "Batch_Alliance",
    Cyto.Group = case_when(
      Cyto.Group == "sole -Y" ~ "LOY",
      Cyto.Group == "CN-AML" ~ "CN_AML",
                           T ~ Cyto.Group)
  )
counts2 <- counts2[,meta2$sample_id]

# Montri
counts3 <- read.table(bulk_files$montri_counts, sep = ",", header = T, row.names = 1)
meta3 <- read.table(bulk_files$montri_metadata, sep = ",", header = T)
colnames(counts3) <- gsub("RNAseqV2","",colnames(counts3))
meta3 <- meta3 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Lab_ID %in% colnames(counts3)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Batch = "Batch_Montri",
    sample_id = Lab_ID,
    Cyto.Group = case_when(
      Cyto.Group == "sole -Y" ~ "LOY",
      Cyto.Group == "CN-AML" ~ "CN_AML",
                           T ~ Cyto.Group)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, `Cyto.Group`, Race, Age, Sex, Batch)

counts3 <- counts3[,meta3$sample_id]

# Merge
merged_counts <- merge(counts1, counts2, by = "row.names", all = F)
rownames(merged_counts) <- merged_counts$Row.names
merged_counts <- merged_counts[,-1]
merged_counts <- merge(merged_counts, counts3, by = "row.names", all = F)
rownames(merged_counts) <- merged_counts$Row.names
merged_counts <- merged_counts[,-1]

merged_meta <- rbind(meta1, meta2, meta3)

```

# Male CN and LOY

```{r}

merged_meta1 <- merged_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sex == "Male") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cyto.Group %in% c("LOY","CN_AML"))
merged_counts1 <- merged_counts[,merged_meta1$sample_id]
rownames(merged_meta1) <- merged_meta1$sample_id
# Generate a summary table for the variable `meta`

summary_table <- table1(~ Race+Age+Sex+Cyto.Group, data = merged_meta)

# Print the summary table
print(summary_table)

summary_table <- table1(~ Race+Age+Sex+Cyto.Group, data = merged_meta1)

# Print the summary table
print(summary_table)

write.csv(merged_counts1, file.path(bulk_dirs$prepared, "counts_male.csv"))
write.csv(merged_meta1, file.path(bulk_dirs$prepared, "samples_male.csv"))
```

# Male and female CN and LOY

```{r}

merged_meta1 <- merged_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cyto.Group %in% c("LOY","CN_AML"))
merged_counts1 <- merged_counts[,merged_meta1$sample_id]
rownames(merged_meta1) <- merged_meta1$sample_id
# Generate a summary table for the variable `meta`

summary_table <- table1(~ Race+Age+Sex+Cyto.Group, data = merged_meta)

# Print the summary table
print(summary_table)

summary_table <- table1(~ Race+Age+Sex+Cyto.Group, data = merged_meta1)

# Print the summary table
print(summary_table)

write.csv(merged_counts1, bulk_files$counts)
write.table(merged_counts1, file.path(bulk_dirs$prepared, "counts.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = F)
write.csv(merged_meta1, bulk_files$metadata)
```

# Cohort summary
```{r}
library(table1)

# Custom summary function for Age to display median and range as whole numbers
custom_summary <- function(x) {
  x <- na.omit(x)
  sprintf("Median (Range): %d (%d-%d)", round(median(x)), floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)))
}

# Rename `Cyto.Group` and modify `CN_AML` labels in the data
merged_meta1 <- merged_meta1 %>%
  mutate(
    Cyto.Group = ifelse(Cyto.Group == "CN_AML", "CN-AML", Cyto.Group),
    Cyto.Group = factor(Cyto.Group, levels = unique(Cyto.Group))  # Ensure proper factor levels
  )

# Update variable labels
label(merged_meta1$Cyto.Group) <- "Cytogenetic Group"
label(merged_meta1$Age) <- "Age (years)"

rndr <- function(x, name, ...) {
    if (!is.numeric(x)) return(render.categorical.default(x))
    what <- switch(name,
        Age = "Median [Min, Max]",
        wt  = "Mean (SD)")
    parse.abbrev.render.code(c("", what))(x)
}

# Create summary table
summary_table <- table1(
  ~ Race + Age + Sex + Cyto.Group,
  data = merged_meta1,
  render = rndr
)

print(summary_table)

```
